profile.summary: A densely clumped native sedge of wetlands, damp forest and stream margins across New Zealand.
profile.lookFor: Narrow light-green leaves form a tussock; stiff upright brown flowering panicles help separate it from drooping Carex secta.
profile.nameNote: NZPCN treats Carex virgata as a species and lists Carex appressa var. virgata as a synonym; Commons uses that older category. Pukio, toitoi and toetoe follow NZPCN’s spellings and are shared names also used for other sedges or grasses.
